title: Identification & 4x4 Raster Suite Generation for Top MT/MST S+ and S- Neurons
notes: Extracted 1,664 MT/MST/FST units across 21 NWB sessions.
Ranked top MT/MST S+ (stimulus-driven) and S- (stimulus-suppressed / delay-active) neurons using 9-element epoch template correlations (r_S+ and r_S-).
Top MT S+ Unit: sub-C31o_ses-230818 Row 441 (ID 79.0, MT), r_S+ = 0.989.
Top MST S- Unit: sub-C31o_ses-230818 Row 462 (ID 100.0, MST), r_S- = 0.943.
Rendered 10 individual 300 DPI 4x4 PNG raster suites with log-scale PSTH panels in outputs/raster_suites/mt_mst_splus/ and outputs/raster_suites/mt_mst_sminus/.
